scope: Per checkpoint, single-channel 2D fixed-geometry conversion fidelity. Scientific qualification is recorded separately.

input.preprocessing: Upstream automatic percentile normalization and centered reflect padding at the native grid. Preserve each original unpadded geometry.

output.host: Upstream sigmoid, L2 normalization across the three flow channels (eps=1e-12), unpadding, peak finding and subpixel refinement; released best-weight thresholds.

cohorts.calibration: Engineering calibration only, frozen hashed list prior to PTQ. Disjoint from the readout by animal for NASA, and by original field for public spot images.
cohorts.readout: All preselected readout inputs, no historical NASA evaluation or final holdout. Public examples are technical deployment inputs.

applies_to: any rearrangement of the neural/host boundary versus native

ip.require: Successful fresh evaluator for this optimized graph with actual neural compute assigned to NPU. Host operations are declared explicitly. A run can characterize IP even when parity fails.

ptq.candidate: Vendor default KL720 PTQ, two analysis threads. Each checkpoint has independent calibration/output scales and qualification.

bie_versus_native.aggregation: Map errors on valid crop pixels and components, point F1 from micro-aggregated TP/FP/FN over all fields, maximum-cardinality within radius then nearest-distance matching. Counts use the registered target nucleus. Include per-input and per-domain results.

nef.validation: Same frozen inputs. Every simulator output tensor must agree with the fixed-point BIE after descriptor-aware decoding, max absolute difference 0.000001 with zero relative tolerance; preserve identical point counts and coordinates within 0.001 pixel.

physical.validation: Nonpersistent NEF upload over USB, verify SHA256 and device descriptors, no firmware changes. Compare every readout to NEF simulator using the same tolerances. Measure resident-model inference and full pipeline through host point decoding; retain raw buffers and timing boundaries.

policy: Keep failed receipts and individual criterion outcomes. Qualify only the checkpoint, geometry, preprocessing, panel and SDK actually measured. These project-defined engineering tolerances make no biological equivalence claim.
